mapper.select: SELECT dr.*, d.device_name, d.device_no, u.real_name AS user_name FROM device_reservation dr LEFT JOIN device d ON dr.device_id = d.id LEFT JOIN `user` u ON dr.user_id = u.id WHERE dr.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO device_reservation(device_id, user_id, reserve_date, time_slot, purpose, status) VALUES(#{deviceId}, #{userId}, #{reserveDate}, #{timeSlot}, #{purpose}, #{status})
